items.headline: Bears anticipate 'great challenge' vs. Brian Flores' Vikings defense

items.headline: Vikings RB Jordan Mason put on IR after having surgery on thumb
items.description: Vikings running back Jordan Mason was placed on injured reserve Wednesday after undergoing surgery to repair a fractured thumb.
